messages:
maria: hey @kevin @olivia — can someone take a quick look at my PR updating dashboard panels + trace hook + metric names? https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5678
kevin: pinged. what's the scope? breaking?
maria: small surface: rename `request.lat_ms` -> `request.latency_ms`, add `trace.session_id` to span attrs for linking, and a dashboard layout change. Also updated alert thresholds (minor). Not a behavioral change, but alerts will need a migrate.
olivia: will try to review in a bit, busy with deploy but should get to it today :+1:
maria: thanks — main files: `observability/metrics/metrics_registry.py`, `runtime/trace/hooks.py`, `internal/dashboard/panels.yaml`
kevin: quick skim — `metrics_registry.py` line ~142 looks like rename but we need a migration path. can you add a short compat alias?
maria: good call. adding alias now. here's the snippet I'm adding:
```
# compat alias
metrics_registry.register_alias('request.lat_ms', 'request.latency_ms')
```
maria: also added a note to the release notes under `docs/release-notes/2026-03-17.md`
ci-bot: build failed — unit tests: tests/metrics/test_registry.py::test_aliasing (flake: race on env)
maria: fixing test, will push in a minute
maria: pushed fix (force remove thread-local init, see commit 9c3f2b)
ci-bot: build passed — all checks green ✅
sam: thanks — can we hold merge until tomorrow's canary window? I'd like to watch traffic for a day
olivia: quick perf sanity: no cpu impact locally. left two tiny nit comments on the PR, otherwise 👍
kevin: LGTM after olivia's nits; agree with sam to wait for canary. can we tag the PR `hold/canary`?
maria: tagged `hold/canary` and scheduled merge for 2026-03-18 09:00 PT. Will post canary dashboard link when live
olivia: thanks — will check traces during canary. :eyes:
maria: awesome, thanks everyone :heart:
